> Source: https://docs.cloud.google.com/composer/docs/versions-packages/

To more strongly embrace the success and growing customer preference for OSS solutions, Cloud Composer is evolving to become **Managed Service for Apache Airflow**. This name change provides improved customer understanding of our portfolio while reinforcing our commitment to being the most open cloud ecosystem.

#  Preinstalled packages changelog Stay organized with collections  Save and categorize content based on your preferences. 

This page lists preinstalled packages in each released Airflow build and package differences between subsequent releases. If you want to see descriptions and support dates of released Managed Airflow versions instead, see [Managed Service for Apache Airflow version list](https://docs.cloud.google.com/composer/docs/composer-versions).

**Note:** It's possible to **compare packages between any non-subsequent releases** using a third-party tool. For more information and an example, see Compare packages between non-subsequent releases.

This section provides a list of preinstalled packages and a list of changes between preinstalled packages in subsequent releases of Managed Airflow (Gen 3).

## Compare packages between non-subsequent releases

In some cases following the package changes one by one isn't feasible, for example, if there is a large gap between versions or if you want to compare a Managed Airflow (Gen 2) version to a Managed Airflow (Gen 3) Airflow build.

In this case, you can compare packages by using a third-party utility, such as the `diff` command-line utility in Linux.

An example of using a `diff` tool to get a list of changes:

  1. Get the full list of packages for each version from this page.
  2. Save each list into a separate file.
  3. Run `diff <filename_earlier_version> <filename_later_version>`.
